# v17.11 Island of Dawn Territory Geometry

Source: unpacked v17.11 client DataCenter (`TerritoryData`). Each zone shard holds `TerritoryGroup`s (id + Korean desc) containing `Territory` fence polygons. The client carries no spawn entries, so the only territory -> NPC hint is the group desc; `subject` is the Korean label the desc names (last parenthetical, else the trailing `_` segment), kept verbatim. English `npc_name_matches` are literal desc substrings only (the descs are Korean, so this is near-always empty and downstream translation is required to map a Korean subject to an English template).
